column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable value of an element of the receiver book: the row `domain/rec/ingest/*/<section>` at the domain holder and the copy at a member, schema `ingest-entry.schema.json#member` (V/02.9 N1.6); the path is from value. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.

column3: a server element not in form: not read, rather than absent — the pusher keeps the addresses of the last read element; none read — no address of this server
a server element not in form: the backup does not read the addresses, the life of the server is judged by the head of the book — the element is not judged
puts the copy of the section as it came, does not judge the value of an element: the unreadable is judged by the reader; the next answer of the door overwrites the row
